observations: Exact visible ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS; full native key histories and status flags. Calculate, Complex and Table Verify are covered.
No Operator has its own relation-selection/Back modal. A valid False is a result, not an error. Syntax ERROR and Math ERROR are separate cases.
Back, AC, EXE and OK dismiss ordinary Verify errors without deleting the expression. Arrows, digits and SETTINGS are ignored on the error; SHIFT followed by AC does not power the calculator off.
After a side-evaluation error the cursor returns to the end of that side. After complex ordering fails it follows the relation. A right-side division-by-zero holdout is included.
Table Verify retains the failed answer draft and cell on return from Syntax/Math ERROR. Correcting 1+ to 1 produces True; acceptance then advances normally. Back can cancel the answer draft.
